اغترفا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَرَفَا (iḡtarafā) /iɣ.ta.ra.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# اُغْتُرِفَا (uḡturifā) /uɣ.tu.ri.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# اِغْتَرِفَا (iḡtarifā) /iɣ.ta.ri.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
